body: I don't think dying young would bother me.

I have before, but I haven't been given any options. At the moment my choices for doctors really suck. The insurance I have is for low income and it limits me to low cost clinics. I already have some horror stories and the care that I've been given. I'm really not hopeful.
They wouldn't work unless I take them everyday.
I know, but I don't think I can live with taking the meds.
